title: Collecting carry Sunday Tea with BNP Paribas

classification.rationale: A multi-asset weekly strategy note whose core message is to stay long risk, collect carry and sell risk premium, with trade ideas across equity calls, rates vol RV, FX carry and FX vol, so no single category fits cleanly.
classification.runner_up_reason: The headline 'collecting carry' and the FX trades (long AUDJPY, short CLPCOP, EURUSD DNT) fit FX carry and vol, but rates vol relative value and Fed commentary take up similar space.
